::: {#exr-cons-list}
#### Building a list with `cons`

In Racket, `empty` is the list with no elements,
and `(cons x xs)` is the list whose first element is `x`, followed by the elements of the list `xs`.
For example, `(cons 5 empty)` is the one-element list `'(5)`.
Write the list `'(7 2 9)` using only `cons`, `empty` and numbers.

:::
